overview: FAM6202 is a sim event focused on olf entries and crosswind patterns. The notes below are organized off the canonical syllabus items first, then filled out with local FAM gouge so students can brief the event, explain the why behind each item, and stay ahead of instructor follow-up questions.

14 – When #1 downwind at the 180, descend to 500‘ MSL. Turn northbound to circle around Redfish Point to the east.
18 – When #1 downwind at the 180, descend to 500‘ MSL. Going “feet wet” turn east.
